instruction: Reorganize the rule set in the native Altium board file `C:\Users\user\Desktop\wifi_board.PcbDoc`. Save the modified native document as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\wifi_ruleset.PcbDoc`. Requirements: - In rule `Clearance_Diff_pair`, change the intra-pair clearance to `8mil` and keep the rule scoped to `InAnyDifferentialPair`. - Change rule `Width` to `MINLIMIT=8mil`, `PREFEREDWIDTH=10mil`, and `MAXLIMIT=12mil`. - Change rule `RoutingVias` to `HOLEWIDTH=12mil`, and set `WIDTH`, `MINWIDTH`, and `MAXWIDTH` all to `28mil`. [Software] To use Altium Designer on Windows, run `D:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE` (adjust if your install path differs).
